Atlanta Braves stock just hit a new all time high. The San Diego Padres are reportedly selling for $3.5 billion. If the Padres are worth that, what are the Braves, who own their stadium and the entire neighborhood Battery real estate around them in addition to the team, worth?
We are moving from Trump is a Nazi to Israel owns Trump back to Trump is a Nazi again in record time.

Oil is now $80 a barrel. When the war started it was $68 a barrel. The stock market is now higher than it was before the Iran war. Soon gas will be cheaper than before the Iran war too.


Trump War Room (@TrumpWarRoom)







— https://nitter.net/TrumpWarRoom/status/2045145515998765380#m
We destroyed their entire military and ended their nuclear ambitions. This is exactly what Bill Clinton should have done to North Korea in the 1990’s. Trump has made the world much safer.
Trump’s going to have to walk out on the Truman balcony with Iran’s nuclear dust and hold it up like Simba from the Lion King for the legacy media to admit he accomplished anything in Iran.

New talking points about to drop for left wingers. From war with Iran will cause World War III and destroy the world economy to nothing happened what was the point of war with Iran? Prepare yourselves.

The Strait of Hormuz blockade by Trump and his team was strategically brilliant. It crippled Iran economically, ended the ridiculous media Iran “control” narrative, increased our negotiating leverage immensely, and had zero cost.
Goodness, the oil price collapse is so fast I have to share another chart.

Oil price collapse as Iran announces the Strait of Hormuz is open to all. Stocks will also surge to yet another record at the opening bell. World War III and an economic apocalypse deferred yet again until the next “crisis.” Blue Sky in total mourning.
I also love the people who tag me and complain that now I’ll just hire them anyway. We’re winning. And when both sides have the same take, the brand is strong. Many thanks.
I love that when people get fired for bullshit reasons in media so many of you immediately tag me on here and say I should hire them. That’s a pretty awesome free speech brand to have created.
